product_metadata.title: 2 Pack Insulated Travel Tumblers for Home School Office Camping, Stainless Steel Double Wall Vacuum Travel Tumbler with 2 Handles, 2 Lids, 4 Straws, 2 Straw Brushes, 1 Cup Brush (30oz, Black & Mint)
features: UNIQUE GIFT FOR MEN AND WOMEN: This insulated tumbler with handle can be gifts for Mother's Day and Father's Day, Christmas, housewarming, BBQ, party cup & more. This insulated travel tumbler pack is also suitable for home use, travelers, students, truck drivers, bus drivers, taxi drivers, teachers, sailors.

DOUBLE WALL VACUUM INSULATED DESIGN: These sweatless travel tumblers are designed with double-wall vacuum insulation, which can keep hot for 5 hours according to the test of our experts. And the sweat-proof design is also a very prominent feature. No matter how long you hold it, there is no sweat at all, and the touch is also very comfortable.

UNBREAKABLE MATERIAL: The stainless steel travel tumblers set are made of 18/8 food grade stainless steel. The cups are very sturdy and not easy to break even if they fall from a height accidentally, economical and durable. You can even decorate the tumbler freely by yourself according to yourself after you get it.

COMPLETE ACCESSORIES: This two pack travel tumblers set is also equipped with 2 lids, 4 straws, 2 handles, 2straw brushes and 1 cup brush. The brush makes the cup easier to clean. The handle makes the insulated tumbler easier to hold.

BPA FREE LID: The tested BPA free lid is very safe in daily use without poison. The tightness of these insulated tumblers are good, because the lids have rubber gaskets. The drinking hole in the lid is also very convenient for you to drink or insert the straw.
